platform: SolidEdge Cloud Platform (SECP) — Engineering Truth OS

noSecondEngineeringCore.details: All domain validations bind exclusively to SECP Engineering Core and canonical schemas.

noParallelSourceOfTruth.details: Design identity, pinout, nets, geometry, and revision hashes derive from single canonical models.

noMockPhysics.details: All reported metrics derive from real mathematical solvers (MNA, ASTM B193, Theta-JA, keepout topology). Unimplemented physics explicitly marked NOT_PROVEN.

noQualificationWithoutRequirements.details: Phase 5 enforces mandatory requirement-to-evidence bidirectional traceability.

noDetachedEvidence.details: Evidence records are cryptographically bound to exact design revision and solver configuration.

noSelfCertification.details: Independent acceptance gates and adversarial mutation suites arbitrate truth.

failClosedSemantics.details: Missing data, unverified models, or solver boundary violations yield BLOCKED or NOT_PROVEN.

noExternalCertificationClaim.details: DO-254, DO-178C, ISO 26262 ASIL D, and IEC 61508 are marked NOT_PROVEN pending external regulatory evidence.
